title: Frozen reference repair scope and next independent version acceptance plan
scope: Full source/kind/split inventory of release-v2 and browser-drone-expansion-v1, with targeted review predicates expanded from the seven flagged coverage references. This is not a full semantic certification of either mixture.
summary_zh: 两个 mixture 共享的 115,821 行在 ID、split、完整行内容上完全一致；所审三个来源共 16,790 个唯一行，不能跨 mixture 相加。
Platformer 的 1,697 行全部逐动作运行真实 _transition：1,097 行证实另有同物理状态/奖励/终止结果的动作，其中 1,086 行空中、11 行地面。余下 600 行仅表示未发现同一步等价，未认证没有其他等优路径。
ViZDoom 精确 movement Choice 模板 3,031 行缺少策略公式、8-tic 投影、10-unit 死区和符号定义；所有 9,093 个源标签均可由现有脚本复算，但规格缺失不等于数值错标。
客服 bug_severity 共 1,000 行：同已审 ID 单账号模板 171 行，其中仅原始 1 行已人工复核为语义歧义，另外 170 行属于同模板待裁定范围。ID 混合 43、OOD 单一改写 19、OOD 混合改写 8 另列，不能算作已确认错误。
本报告只定义独立新版本的修订及验收，不修改旧数据、gold、已有分数、模型或活跃任务，也未生成或训练新版本。

platformer.limitation: The complement is not certified semantically unique or optimal: different next states may still be equally successful or shortest paths. This audit checks the immediate gold-equivalent action class, not a complete BFS optimum set.

grounded_equivalence_example.explanation: A height-2 column blocks the second run step: both right and right_run move from x=21 to x=22 with reward +1. This is why filtering only airborne states would miss eleven confirmed cases.

counting_units.definition: A row with two non-gold actions equal to gold counts as one affected row and two alternative row-action pairs. Counts are not rollouts, episodes or a sum across the overlapping mixtures.

doom.exact_movement_question: Which lateral movement does the momentum-aware tracking policy choose to align with the nearest visible target?
doom.limitation: This confirms an omitted-policy specification for the matched Choice template. It does not mean that every gold label is numerically wrong, every state allows a different answer, or any provider failed to understand Doom.

customer.purpose: Read-only customer-support scope audit for parent reference-repair plan. No repo files, frozen datasets, labels, provider scores, models or jobs were changed.

method.scope: Select source customer-control-v1. A severity row must have kind=score and exactly match the visible question/options below. Metadata question_id is only a cross-check.
method.question_exact: How severe is the reported issue? Use the stated functional impact and the existence of a workaround. Use no functional impact when no malfunction is described. In this synthetic control, if a broken feature is described but the availability of a workaround is explicitly unknown, the two latent possibilities (workaround exists; no workaround exists) are equally likely.
options_exact: Broken or degraded feature; workaround exists
method.id_issue_exact: I need access restored after changing the email address used to sign in.
method.ood_issue_exact: After our administrator changed my sign-in identity, I need the permissions on my profile restored.

single_priority_markers.id: That is the request I want you to handle first.
single_priority_markers.ood: Please treat that request as my first priority.

mixed_priority_markers.id: Both of those requests matter equally to me; I have not chosen one to address first.
mixed_priority_markers.ood: Neither of these two requests takes precedence; they have equal priority.

full_issue_line_regexes.id: ^(?:Customer Harbor-[a-f0-9]+: |Customer message: )I\ need\ access\ restored\ after\ changing\ the\ email\ address\ used\ to\ sign\ in\.\ That\ is\ the\ request\ I\ want\ you\ to\ handle\ first\.$
full_issue_line_regexes.ood: ^(?:Visitor Cedar-[a-f0-9]+: |Member wrote: )After\ our\ administrator\ changed\ my\ sign\-in\ identity,\ I\ need\ the\ permissions\ on\ my\ profile\ restored\.\ Please\ treat\ that\ request\ as\ my\ first\ priority\.$

method.negative_check_for_single: Assert none of the same-bank complete bug, bug_unknown, billing, or feature_request utterances occur anywhere in state.
method.mixed_classification: Shared account utterance plus exact equal-priority marker and exactly one other complete issue utterance from the same visible phrase bank; no hidden category values determine cohort membership.
method.canonical_sha256: SHA-256 of json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False).encode(UTF-8). Row hash covers complete original row.

denominators.outside_account_inventory_statement: Outside this targeted audit; not declared semantically clean or erroneous.

reviewed_reference.status: Previously manually reviewed: semantic ambiguity; gold 0 fits no-explicit-malfunction reading, but account access restoration may imply functional loss. Neither automatic retention as uniquely correct nor relabeling to 2 is justified; no explicit absence of workaround is given.

id_single_exact.status: Same reviewed visible account-only/single-priority issue template. This is a scope for adjudication, not 171 proven erroneous labels. Only the original reference has been individually reviewed for semantic ambiguity.

id_mixed.status: Different mixed-priority context; unreviewed inventory, cannot automatically infer ambiguity or incorrectness from the shared account substring.

limitations: 171 exact-template matches consist of 1 individually reviewed ambiguous reference and 170 additional rows sharing its issue template. The 170 were structurally inspected, not independently semantically adjudicated.
Different tone, renewal intent, language suffix and dialogue envelope remain visible context. The exact issue predicate does not prove all complete dialogues have identical interpretations.
ID mixed rows (43), OOD single rows (19), and OOD mixed rows (8) remain separate unreviewed inventories. Their 70 rows must not be added to 171 as confirmed defects.
Mixed bug_workaround and bug_blocking cases explicitly state functional impact and alternative availability; matching the account substring does not invalidate their reference.
Each conversation yields 6 question rows. Only bug_severity Score is in the semantic issue scope. The 5 companion question rows are inventory only, not flagged.
Latent categories and generator ambiguity tags are cross-checks of generation intent, not visible evidence that a rubric label is uniquely entailed.

Both mixture copies are byte-equivalent after canonical row serialization, with identical IDs and split assignments; these cohort counts apply to each mixture and must be counted once for unique-row totals.
next_independent_version_repair_recommen: Define severity target scope explicitly: all current reported issues versus a designated issue; for multiple issues state an aggregation rule or ask separate per-issue severity questions.

Write routine-account examples with explicit absence of malfunction and functional loss if gold 0 is intended. If access is blocked, state functional impact and whether a workaround is available instead of deriving severity from category=account.
Keep routing category and severity separate; account/billing/feature_request labels must not force severity 0 when visible content states impairment.

For naturally underspecified cases, add an explicit insufficient-evidence output or exclusion policy decided before evaluation. Do not manufacture calibrated soft probabilities from an unobserved category tag.

Independently adjudicate the 171 same-template rows and review OOD/mixed cohorts separately. Derive final labels from state+question+options only. Preserve source IDs in a migration ledger with old/new row digests and repair reason.
Validate full fan-out groups together after wording changes, because changed functional impact can change severity/reproducibility signals even if category is retained.

Create a new dataset/config/version with a distinct hash and freeze it before any new model/provider evaluation. Preserve existing release-v2, expansion, provider requests/gold/scores and active training inputs.
next_version_acceptance_checks: Every revised severity reference has a visible evidence record identifying scope, functional impact and workaround; reviewers do not see control_latents or target during judgment.
For each revised one-hot label, two independent visible-only judgments agree with the intended rubric outcome; unresolved ambiguity follows the predefined abstention/exclusion policy.
Counterfactual fixtures hold category fixed while changing impact/workaround and verify severity changes; switching category alone while preserving evidence cannot change severity.
Mixed-issue examples and both ID/OOD phrase families have explicit severity scope and receive separate review. Billing/feature/account distractors cannot be silently treated as severity instructions.
Split disjointness is checked at original group/template family level; all 6 fan-out rows from a conversation remain together and changed wording does not introduce cross-split leakage.
All repaired cohort IDs are accounted for in the migration ledger. Old file hashes are rechecked unchanged. The new version has fresh manifests and locked evaluation inputs.

versioning: Create a separate version/config and manifests. Existing release-v2, browser-drone-expansion-v1, provider requests/gold/scores and their hashes remain frozen.

Record old record/group IDs and row hashes, new IDs/hashes, repair reason, visible-evidence contract and adjudication outcome in a migration ledger. Inventory candidates are not automatically relabelled or removed.

Keep repaired descendants of a frozen heldout group out of training. Freeze a fresh independent evaluation set with disjoint seed/terrain/episode/conversation groups before training or provider evaluation; keep the seven reviewed cases as regression evidence.

Predeclare categorical/set-valued and probability metrics, provider parsing/validation and failure treatment. Run every compared provider on the same newly frozen requests. Keep original primary scores and any new-version scores in separate reports.

platformer.recommended_contract: Choose an action on a shortest successful path under the disclosed local tile physics. Accept every such action; state this minimum-action objective explicitly in the new request.
reference_definition: Let V(s) be the minimum remaining action count to reach the flag without death; V(success)=0 and V(unreachable)=infinity.
For every legal action, call the exact engine transition. Accept a iff it does not die and 1 + V(next_state) = V(s), treating a successful terminal transition as V(next_state)=0.

Compute the complete optimal first-action set over the visible finite state graph, not just the first path returned by action enumeration. The 1,097 confirmed same-transition cases are a lower bound on possible nonunique optimal actions.

Store accepted action sets for hard decision scoring. If the training schema requires a target distribution, use uniform support over the accepted set and document it as a supervision convention, not a calibrated probability of winning.
An unreachable state needs a predeclared exclusion or explicit no-success action policy; do not manufacture a successful target.
platformer.alternative_only_if_policy_imitation_is_: A separate policy-imitation task may expose the complete BFS algorithm and action tie order in its visible request and retain a unique canonical action. Do not silently use that policy-imitation label for an unconstrained reach-the-flag objective.
acceptance_checks: For every revised state, reconstructed observe() equals the visible state, and all declared options are legal.
An independently checked shortest-path value agrees with every accepted first action. Changing BFS action iteration order leaves the accepted action set unchanged.
Every pair with identical next physical state/dead/terminal/reward has the same acceptance status. Include all 1,097 affected IDs and grounded clipping cases in the migration audit.

Cover airborne jump/no-jump equivalence, grounded walk/run blocked at a column, landing/falling phases, gaps, flag arrival, death and unreachable states. A failing path cannot receive mass solely because it was enumerated first.
All states of an identical full terrain layout stay in one split, including repaired descendants and independently generated repeated layouts; every target is normalized over legal accepted actions.

doom_movement.recommended_contract: Imitate the explicitly supplied weak momentum-tracking script, not optimal Doom play.

visible_policy_required.ready: nearest_visible_enemy is not null, health > 0, ammo > 0; otherwise Hold lateral movement.
visible_policy_required.coordinates: relative_bearing_deg is in degrees and positive to the player left; lateral_units_per_tic is positive left. Convert degrees to radians before sin.
visible_policy_required.decision: Strafe left if e > 10; Strafe right if e < -10; Hold lateral movement when -10 <= e <= 10.
visible_policy_required.action_duration: action_window_tics is the environment action duration (4 or 8 in the frozen examples), not the projection horizon. Keep both meanings explicit.
visible_policy_required.numeric_input: Compute the reference from the rounded numeric values actually supplied to the model; document comparison boundaries and precision.

acceptance_checks: The serialized runtime request and dataset row include the same formula, units, horizon, readiness rule and inclusive deadband; no required parameter exists only in metadata or teacher code.

A standalone calculation from state plus visible rules reproduces every new movement target. Fixtures cover e at -10 and +10, either side, zero/nonzero/opposite momentum, and positive/negative bearings.
No target, zero ammunition and dead-player fixtures select Hold; action_window_tics=4 and 8 do not accidentally change a separately fixed 8-tic prediction horizon.
Changing an exposed horizon/deadband changes boundary fixture labels according to the written policy; graders must not retain hidden old constants.

Keep attack Noul and alignment Score as independent tasks. Verify their own target/ammo/health and angle boundaries 3/6/12/22 degrees; do not exclude these tasks just because the movement prompt was incomplete.
Episode grouping and independently reserved OOD seeds/control regimes remain disjoint. Continue labeling this as a weak script reference without optimal-play claims.

customer_severity.unknowns: Automatic substring/category matching cannot resolve the reviewed account-access ambiguity or certify mixed/OOD cases. Do not automatically change gold 0 to 2, and do not invent equal-probability labels for naturally missing evidence.

completion_gates: All selected migration IDs have an explicit disposition; all retained hard references meet their new visible contract; unresolved semantics are withheld under a predeclared policy.
Fresh manifests, all split counts/hashes, group disjointness, normalized targets and runtime/data request parity pass before freezing the independent evaluation.
All old input hashes still match this report. No repair is applied in place to frozen provider inputs, past scores or an active training run.
Only after a new dataset/model/evaluation is actually built and verified may a report claim repaired benchmark quality or changed provider accuracy. This plan does not make either claim.

methods.canonical_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False). Sorted-ID hashes serialize lexicographically sorted complete ID lists.
methods.mixture_identity: Read every row from all ten split files, reject duplicate IDs, verify row split, compare full canonical row hashes for all release-v2 IDs in expansion, and verify observed source/split counts against manifests.
methods.platformer: Reconstruct TilePlatformer from visible terrain length/columns and player/trajectory position; assert observe()==state and legal actions==options. For each of seven actions call the source _transition and reproduce step reward (-1 on death, else horizontal progress). Compare complete physical next-state/dead/done/reward tuples with one-hot gold. No BFS optimum-set search was run.
methods.future_equivalence_basis: For fixed terrain, future physics/termination/reward depend on the physical position tuple and episode terminal state. The previous_action bookkeeping tag is not used by _transition, observe, teacher_actions or reward; equal tuples preserve future physical behavior under the same subsequent actions.
methods.doom: Match the exact movement question and options, verify complete visible state field shape has no extra policy declaration, and reproduce all 9,093 Choice/Noul/Score targets with expert_decision. This is a script-consistency check, not a claim that every visible target is unique or game-optimal.
methods.customer: A peer inspected full visible issue lines, exact severity question/options and phrase banks. Independently rechecked all 241 candidate row hashes, exact single-issue regexes with negative checks and mixed-issue visible predicates; no hidden category field determines cohort membership.
